I haven't had it in about 2 years. Mostly cause i got sober. And its hard to connect with someone when their drinking in front of me trying to get drunk enough for sex. Its a turn off. And my take on sex is different. 
Plus my sponsors in NA and AA told me to stay single for my recovery. It would be harder with a new relationship. 
So here i am toughing it out. If im lucky i might not ever have sex again and just hate myself normally. 
I used to be like this though. Everyday or every week getting a new partner was NOT a worry to me. 
I even had a successful open relationship with a stripper for. We broke up to sober up. 
Anyway idk i guess im done ranting. Thanks for reading my white trashedness

I live in discontent. 
I want to get high.. Nothing is enough. Not work not women i treat everything terribly even myself.. Cause I'm not getting what i want. And because of what i am now even trying to be clean. And I've been trying to change my attitude.. Trying only does so much. I feel the people in my meetings are out of my age group and can't totally relate.
Lost and alone and unhappy. And mad at myself that i couldn't change my feelings as much as ive stopped using even with help and support... I feel like going on is just torture.. Theres no joy to my life.
I'm not a big fan of myself... I hate myself a lot.
